svg.title: Claims assistant - Azure target architecture
svg.desc: Proposed architecture. Complete preprocessing runs in one Azure Databricks workflow. A prompt OR hosted agent runs natively in Microsoft Foundry Agent Service, not in an application container host. One Foundry account supplies CU, embeddings and chat. Separate request, data-return and telemetry paths.
svg.text: Databricks preprocessing; native Foundry Agent Service. Proposed, not deployed.
Parse + deduplicate | Chunk + embed | Persist + index
Jobs / notebooks; persisted outputs in Blob / ADLS
